title: A Cosmic Miracle: A Remarkably Luminous Galaxy at z_spec = 14.44 Confirmed with JWST

evidence.locator: abstract: z_spec = 14.44 +0.02 -0.02; 280 million years after the Big Bang; circularized r_e = 74 +15 -12 pc; M_UV = -20.2. Position 150.0933255°, 2.2731627° as SIMBAD records it with this paper as its coordinate reference.

Section 3.2 (morphology) and Table 1, read from the arXiv source: forcepho Sérsic fit to F200W, F277W and F356W; Sérsic index 1.0 +0.2 -0.2; circularized r_e 74 +15 -12 pc; semi-major axis a = 147 +19 -20 pc; axis ratio b/a = 0.25 +0.11 -0.06; thumbnails at 30 mas per pixel, 98 pc at z = 14.44; the source is extended along the North-South direction in the thumbnails. No position angle is tabulated.

statements.text: The position is SIMBAD's transcription from the paper; the paper's own table was not read here.
